prerequisites: Prior knowledge of Graphical Expression course.

learning_outcomes.text: Interpret and represent engineering structure and installation plans.
Correctly use specifications, regulations, and mandatory norms for the graphic representation of industrial installations.
Customize CAD applications oriented to installations and specific drawings.
Organize and manage CAD systems in companies.
Exchange drawing files between applications and via the Internet.

syllabus_topics: Software CAD / BIM / MEP / Visualization / Animation / Simulation.
BIM Systems. Parametric modeling of structures and architecture.
Scientific visualization. Animation and Simulation of 3D models.
Exchange of drawing files between different computer applications.
Principles of dimensioning applicable to industrial installations. Standards.
teaching_methods: Individual project with corresponding report and oral presentation

assessment_methods.method: Active participation in the course and completion of proposed exercises (EV4)

assessment_rules: To be eligible for evaluation, students must attend at least 80% of practical classes (Classroom and Laboratory Practices); otherwise, they will be considered as 'not presented' in Continuous Assessment. The final grade is calculated as 0.75 x EV2 + 0.25 x EV4, provided all minimums are met. If minimums are not met, the final grade will be the minimum between the calculated score and 4.0. For extraordinary evaluation, students must resubmit a personal project, either corrected or new. Differentiated evaluation students participate via virtual campus and submit a personal project.
